summary: F8 - install the CI-built NSIS installer on the clean VM and uninstall it, recording what is left against what was there before

coordination.notes: F8's blocked-on line named E3, which merged in PR #335 along with E2 and E10, so the stated blocker is gone. A different one was found in its place and is fixed here rather than worked around: the ci.yml `tauri` job built the installer and discarded it, so the artefact F8 and F9 both name had never existed on any run. `gh api repos/dancockrell/dr-companion/actions/runs/33972082431/artifacts` printed nothing for a run whose tauri job is success. This lane adds the upload to the existing job - it does not add a second build workflow beside it, and release.yml keeps its own tag-triggered publish, which answers a different question (a signed-off release, not a per-commit build). E3 in docs/verification/first-run-2026-09-05.md exercised a LOCALLY built installer; F8 repeats it on the CI one and records the differences.
